title: Avro Lancaster PB475
memorial_details: Small blue circular plaque with central illustration of a Lancaster in flight, set into a large stone. White coloured inscription, names, drawing and border edgings.
inscription: Six young airmen / died at this spot on / 6 March 1945. / Participants in, and victims of the / human preoccupation with war. / Great lives cut short / Royal Air Force / (3 Names) / Royal Australian Air Force / (3 Names) / We remember them.
community_connection: Great lives cut short. Royal Air Force (3 Names). Royal Australian Air Force (3 Names). Community connection to the airmen.
